text: あたしの　パウワウの　ほうが　その　ばいは　かわいいわよ！

structure.jp: あたしの　パウワウの　ほうが

patterns.name: 〜のほうが
patterns.span: パウワウの　ほうが
patterns.explanation: のほうが picks one side out of two as the one that is more so. パウワウの　ほうが = 'Seel is the one that is more...'.

patterns.name: 〜は (at least)
patterns.explanation: は after an amount means 'at least that much'. その　ばいは = 'at least twice that'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end, here with よ, is a feminine way of stating something firmly. かわいいわよ = 'it's cute, I tell you!'.
